name: Brazilian-Style Peel And Eat Shrimp with Fried Garlic (Camarao ao Alho)

instructions.primary_message: Add oil and 3/4 of garlic to a 30-cm skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until garlic is golden brown, about 5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer garlic to a bowl.

Increase heat to high and heat until oil just starts smoking. Add shrimp all at once and cook, stirring and tossing frequently, until starting to turn pink, about 1 minute. Return cooked garlic and remaining fresh garlic to pan, cook until shrimp is completely cooked through, about 1 minute longer, season with salt, transfer to a plate, and serve with lemon.

schema_metadata.keywords: Brazil, garlic, Latin American cuisine, quick, seafood, shrimp

description: I wanted to eat everything in Brazil. My wife was happy with just the beach and an endless pile of camarão a alho, the Brazilian version of garlic shrimp: diminutive ruby-red, briny, thin-shelled gems, complete with head and legs, glistening in olive oil and fried garlic. Here's how to make them at home.
notes: Notes: For best results, use live, head-on shrimp. Look for shrimp about 5-cm long (with the head), about 25-30 to a pound.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
